links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, SMOG, word count) of chatbot answers to refractive surgery patient questions
links.effect: No significant readability differences between ChatGPT and Gemini. Harder questions produced longer, more complex responses with higher Gunning Fog and SMOG scores.
links.quote: Harder questions resulted in longer and more complex responses, as indicated by higher Gunning Fog and SMOG Index scores.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates off-the-shelf generative LLMs (ChatGPT and Google Gemini) on patient questions related to refractive surgery without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
